notes.title: Update 0.11b1:
notes.notes:
With new changes to the base movement system and some quality of life changes, it is time to have everyone who wants to test it!

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Updated the base player movement to be 50% slower.
[i]*This is to encourage using the weapons for movement more often and to make the player feel more like a person rather than a sled.[/i]
[*]Level 1 bench added
[*]Level 2 parkour course disabled due to renovations
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Moved controls to their own category in the settings option.
[i]*The options for controls was kind of out of place, it now has got it's own area, thanks to Tommy for suggesting it![/i]
[*]Separated the upgrade and the store points
[i]*It was a little silly that players had to choose between getting an upgrade on a weapon, or getting a skin, so to simplify, they got separated.[/i]
[*]Crosshair setting now has a button to open the folder for custom crosshairs for easier access.
[*]Made destructible surfaces more easy to spot.
[*]Made the shotgun more easy to spot.
[*]Pylons are now color coded and show what they activate more clearly.
[*]Changes the pylon activation sound.
[*]After finishing a level, gives notification of currencies gained.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved sliding behavior.
[i]*Sliding up or down slopes was jittery, this should now be fixed.[/i]
[*]Picking up guns while standing on top of them no longer teleports you out of the map.
[*]Turning off noclip while in the air and paused no longer makes you fall super slowly while still paused,
[*]Pylons in the level zone can no longer be activated before the level starts.
[*]Shotgun reload will no longer continue while paused.
[*]Upgrade stations screen can no longer be collided with on the weapon unlock screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.10.3:
notes.notes:
Halloween added (Available on the 25th for 30 days every year.)

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Happy Halloween!
[*] The controls section in the options now has a category select.
[*] Updated the way the scoring system worked.
[*] Added descriptions to specific items.
[*] Added an options in the accessibility settings menu to have minimal VFX.
This will make all particle effects significantly smaller.
[*] Made the settings file save dropdown menu's with their actual values rather than integer values.
-Note: integer values will still work, so older settings files will still work properly, but will be converted to the new version.

[*] Rocket Launcher Changes:
-Added the Quick Eject alt fire to the rocket launcher.
-Changes max ammo count from 10 > 4

[*] Leaderboards have been reset and are now on version 0.11.
(Getting ready for the next big 0.11 update).
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that made the rocket launcher load the same amount as the shotgun on level start.
[*]Fixed a bug that displayed the wrong level name on the [Leaderboards] tab on the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.10.2b10
notes.notes:
Fixed shooting directly down or up with the rocket launcher when having a roof above the player not propelling the player.

Fixed the upgrade station sometimes allowing empty or unavailable upgrades to be selected and be bought and in general being more reliable.

Fixed your personal best displaying an impossibly long time when playing a (parkour) level for the first time.

This should be the last beta (the 'b' in each patch) update, we will be going to 0.10.3 next, or maybe even 0.11 if the changes are large enough, but I think it'll be the former rather than the latter.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b9.1
notes.notes:
The Rocket Launcher blast will now affect triggers, such as pylons.
The Rocket Launcher's projectile will now explode when hitting health based triggers, such as pylons.

Weapons now also track how much they have hit and how many times they are fired.
Hit system got updated to count any health based trigger as a hit.

The stat display for weapons now has an "All" options at the top, to change the display of stats for all weapons instead of having to change each individually.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b9
notes.notes:
Revamped the stats display to look better and be easier to view.

Fixed the leaderboards in the main menu not displaying due to a name convention change.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b8h1
notes.notes:
Changed the upgrades on the rocket launcher to be less powerful.
They were previously:
[list]
[*] Fire Rate [3]
[*] Bullet Amount [4]
[*] Lower Reload [3]
[*] Increase Mag [3]
[*] Increase Damage [3]
[/list]

This is now:
[list]
[*] Fire Rate [3]
[*] Lower Reload [3]
[*] Quick Eject [1] (In development)
[/list]

Fixed the rocket launcher not resetting your falling speed.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b8
notes.notes:
Changed the names of the levels.
Fixed gap in the case display that allowed you to click other cases.

Halved the rocket launchers explosion power.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b7h1
notes.notes:
Fixed rocket explosion sometimes not propelling the player when detonated too closely.
Fixed leaderboard images sometimes showing player icons when no name or score was displayed.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b7
notes.notes:
It's finally been done.
The rocket launcher has been fixed and added.
However, since it's very new and has not had the treatment the other weapons have had, please let me know if anything should be changed!
I'm still very much looking to change and improve this weapon, so testing it is very appreciated ^^

It's currently available in the upgrade station for 50 upgrade points, since I don't have a level to put it in yet (and ofc the testing scene).

Also fixed a bug where the alt fire crosshair would show up if you had no weapons.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b6
notes.notes:
Added 2 new cases, these include:

[h3]-Pride Skins Case, this includes weapon skins that use colors from it's associated pride flag.[/h3]
*note: A playtester requested a trans gun skin, but I felt like that was excluding the rest of the LGBTQI+, so I decided to make an entire case dedicated to this. I could always add more to it if needed

[h3]-Development Case, this includes skins that playtesters that were very helpful during the first public.[/h3]playtest suggested I add.
*note: Not all the skins suggested have been added yet and not all weapon skin features are added yet.

Also, in future playtests, more items will be added to the developmental case as a similar reward.

In this update some icons have also changed, such as the icons for universal weapons.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b5
notes.notes:
Fixed issue with unbox sometimes breaking due to it trying to load non existent items or loading from an empty list.
Added a star to a case if everything inside said case has been unboxed.

Added a "Saved options" display to the options menu to show that the options have been saved,

Changed the way the gun rotates around the player to be more smooth.

Presumably fixed "New PB" showing up if you gain the same time.

Thanks to Moppy and PolipPT for finding these issues!

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b4
notes.notes:
Fixed(?) a bug that made personal best sometimes not load your own.

Smoke that ejects from the barrel will no longer pass through objects.
Smoke will also now eject from your barrel on different weapon and regular field of views.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b3
notes.notes:
If a weapon upgrade only goes up to 1 (such as making a weapon automatic or unlocking the alt fire) the upgrade station will not display "Enabled"/"Disabled" instead of 1/1 and 0/1.

Any collectable you pick up will now be available in the "Collectables" tab.
So any of the books found for example will be available from there once they've been read once, you will no longer have to go back into the level to read it.

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b2
notes.notes:
Weapons skins have now been added to the game.
Currently the only ones available are universal, so every weapon will use the skin.

With this update also came that some of the cases in the store now have dupe protection!
This means that if you click the (i) on a case and it shows "No Duplicates", you will always get a new item!
(Up until you have everything...)

notes.title: Patch 0.10.2b1
notes.notes:
Weapons now are no longer obtainable through the store (at least the ones currently in-game).
Instead, you will find the weapons inside of the levels themselves.

When not connected to steam, the game will now show it's own achievement notification when achieving them.

The unboxing UI will now no longer break when changing resolution.

The setting to change resolution has been enabled again.
Since this is still experimental, please do try it out and let me know if anything does not work properly!

You can now reset your achievements on the achievements tab in the main menu.

You can now reset your stats in the stats tab on the main menu.

notes.title: Update 0.10.1: Playtest Changes
notes.notes:
[h1]The 0.10.1 Update: [b]Playtest Changes[/b][/h1]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Leaderboard version updated to 0.10
[*]Weapons now shoot from the players pov for more reliable shots.
[*]Shotgun fire rate reduced: 0.75s > 0.8s.
[*]Improvements to grappling indicator.
[*]Grappling hook will now cancel when the player is completely stationary for a whole second.
[*]When gaining enough items in your inventory, you will now be able to scroll to view them.
[*]Doors will no longer crush the player when crouching inside a door.
[*]Updated all areas with scrolling to be faster.
[*]Added the mlm flag to the pride case (was already in game files, just forgot to add).
[*]Upgrade station is no longer able to steal your grappling hook.
[*]Grappling onto a moving target now will detach you when it no longer connects to the grappling point.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]The weapon being displayed in the upgrade station will no longer be able to steal your grapple rope.
[*]You can no longer skip across death triggers.
[*]Weapon smoke particles should no longer be visible through walls.
[*]Pylons and doors will now update their sound with the SFX audio setting properly.
[*]Non-Wallrunnable surfaces will no longer reset your double-jump and times you touched a wall.
[*]Fixed controls not showing up and settings not saving properly in level 2 and 3.
[*]Fixed some issues with the console which should improve its performance handling.
[*]Fixed sliders not updating correctly when changing too quickly.
[*]Fixed bug with grappling hook that let you move while paused.
[*]Fixed achievements not being granted immediately when achieved.
[*]Fixed issue where players could stand on top of some triggers.
[*]Fixed issue where alternate fires cooldown would reset when switching weapons.
[*]Fixed scoreboard sometimes displaying incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.10: Gameplay Revamp
notes.notes:
[h1]The 0.10 Update: [b]Gameplay Revamp[/b][/h1]
Officially going from 0.9 to 0.10 and moving out of the 0.10 beta, there have been many changes.
Here is the changelog:

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[*]Achievements
[*]Interactable pylons
[*]Online leaderboards
[*]Added damage indicator
[*]Added customizable crosshairs
[*]Leaderboard display on main menu
[*]Cases display odds, returns and contents
[*]Inventory Items now display collection icon
[*]Slightly adjusted player movement parameters
[*]Accessibility options to change multiple in-game colors
[*]Console displays messages in varying colors for clearity
[*]Doors check if anybody is inside to prevent being pushed out of bounds

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[*]Pistol has bouncing bullets
[*]Pistol Grappling hook works correctly
[*]Pistol Grappling hook has visual range indicator
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed keybinds actually being changeable
[*]Fixed interact menu still showing up sometimes when reading lore
[*]Fixed bug that if pausing and dying at the same time would softlock the player
[*]Fixed bug where the game thought you were permanently doing a parkour course
[*]Fixed game not remembering correct weapon that was last used when switching levels
[*]Fixed parkour trails being permanently stuck in the world when turning the setting off mid-course

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.10b8
notes.notes:
Cases in the shop now have an (i) that can be clicked to display information about the case.
This information includes the chances for each rarity and if the case has a price, the returns if you get a dupe.

Clicking a case now opens a menu showing what is inside, it's name, the option to open it and it's price.

You can also click the Pause key or the SKIP button when opening a case to skip the animation.

Gave every item from a unique case it's own icon in the inventory.

notes.title: Patch 0.10b7
notes.notes:
Added some books the player can read to learn how to do basic movements.
(Might get removed in future updates when the level better conveys what to do)

notes.title: 0.10.b6
notes.notes:
The leaderboards have been reset!
Now that the parkour bugs that resulted in really quick times have been resolved, it's time for all legit runs B)

 All but gun shot audio have changed and some new ones have been added for audible feedback.

Rocket launcher disabled until fixed.

notes.title: Patch 0.10b5h4
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where the console no longer combined identical logs into 1 due to color and thuss slowing down your game significantly with a lot of console log messages.

notes.title: 0.10b5h3
notes.notes:
Made more of the UI elements use the accessibility colors and added the alt-fire as a color option.
Fixed some missing ui elements in-game, such as the interact prompt.

notes.title: Patch 0.10b5h2
notes.notes:
The console will now remember what command were used in previous scenes and display them.
You can now change keybinds in the Options > General at the top with the controls buttons.

notes.title: Patch 0.10b5h1
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with the parkour course that made the game believe you were in parkour purgatory.
Fixed that you do not lose achievements already obtained on steam and the game rechecks that you have all the steam achievements that correspond to achievements gained in-game.

notes.title: 0.10b5
notes.notes:
Console now display suggested commands correctly.
Overall console improvements.
Adjusted pistol upgrade/default behaviour.
Grappling hook upgrade now has a visual indicator if you are in range to grapple.
Spinner hitbox improved.

Fixed bug with sliding not initiating properly.
Fixed bug where you would get teleported back to the floor when trying to jump sometimes.
Fixed staircases sometimes making you fly upward.

notes.title: 0.10b4
notes.notes:
Various changes in level 1.
Overhauled level 3.
Added leaderboard display option on the main menu.
Made game remember your last used weapon when you load into a level.
Added new crosshair options.

notes.title: 0.10b3h1
notes.notes:
Fixed shotgun dashing in the direction it faces instead of the user.
Increased height on crouch tutorial boards to not bump your head whilst sliding.
Made the retry button properly work and save your last used weapon.

notes.title: 0.10b3
notes.notes:
Leaderboards now show avatars + the name of the level you cleared.
Leaderboards should also now take in your online time rather than your local time if you are connected to the internet.
Doors now check if the area they want to close to is occupied before closing.
Made the console accessible after the level ends for debugging.

notes.title: 0.10b2h5
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where dying uploaded a score

notes.title: 0.10m1o1s2
notes.notes: Added aa single consumable *WARNING, ONE TIME USE ONLY*

notes.title: 0.10b2h4
notes.notes: Added a deathbox below the wallrunning segment in the first level.

notes.title: Patch 0.10b2h3
notes.notes: Fixed continue button and moved level 1 secret spawn

notes.title: Patch 0.10b2h2
notes.notes: Actually fixed the time upload issue I think (trust)

notes.title: Patch 0.10b3
notes.notes: Changed the way air movement works to preserve speed more

notes.title: Patch 0.10b2h1
notes.notes: Fixed a 1 millisecond difference in uploaded runs

notes.title: Patch 0.10b2
notes.notes: Started the revamp on level 2 and made the leaderboards save differently so that in future updates I might not have to reset everything if I'm just changing 1 specific part!
